units.source_text: 薰大将则定于四月初十迎接浮舟入京。

en.t: General Kaoru had fixed the tenth day of the fourth month to bring Ukifune to the capital.

units.source_text: 浮舟不愿“随波处处行”，

en.t: Ukifune did not want to be carried wherever the waves might take her,

units.source_text: 她想：“我的命运真奇怪！

en.t: and she thought, "How strange my fate is!

units.source_text: 不知将来如何结局？”

en.t: I do not know how it will end in the future."

units.source_text: 但觉心绪缭乱，打算到母亲处暂住，以便从容考虑。

en.t: Her mind was in turmoil, and she planned to stay for a while with her mother so she could think things over calmly.

units.source_text: 但常陆守家里因为少将的妻子产期将近，正在诵经祈祷，喧哗扰攘。

en.t: But at the Hitachi governor's house, the minor captain's wife was near her time, so sutras and prayers were being recited amid great noise and bustle.

units.source_text: 即使去了，也不便同母亲赴石山进香。

en.t: Even if she went there, it would not be convenient for her to go with her mother on a pilgrimage to Ishiyama.

units.source_text: 于是常陆守夫人到宇治来了。

en.t: So the wife of the Hitachi governor came to Uji.

units.source_text: 乳母出来迎接，对夫人说：“大将送了许多衣料来给侍女们做衣服。

en.t: The nurse came out to greet her and said to the lady, "The general has sent a great deal of cloth to make clothes for the attendants.

units.source_text: 万事总要办得尽善尽美才好。

en.t: Everything ought to be arranged as perfectly as possible.

units.source_text: 然而叫我这老婆子一人做主，生怕办得全然不成样子呢。”

en.t: But if an old woman like me is left to decide everything alone, I am afraid it will turn out quite badly."

units.source_text: 她兴致勃勃地谈长说短。

en.t: She went on talking eagerly about one thing after another.

units.source_text: 浮舟听了，想道：“如果做出怪事来让人耻笑，母亲和乳母又如何想法呢？

en.t: When Ukifune heard this, she thought, "If I do something strange and make people laugh at me, what will my mother and my nurse think?

units.source_text: 那蛮不讲理的匂亲王今天也有信来，

en.t: That unreasonable Prince Niou has sent another letter today,

units.source_text: 说‘你纵然遁迹层云里，

en.t: saying, 'Even if you hide yourself among layers of clouds,

units.source_text: 我也定要寻到，与你同归于尽。

en.t: I will surely find you and die together with you.

units.source_text: 还望你安心下来，跟我去隐居吧。’

en.t: Please calm your heart and come away with me to live in hiding.'

units.source_text: 叫我怎么办呢？”

en.t: What am I supposed to do?"

units.source_text: 她心绪恶劣，躺卧在床。

en.t: Her spirits were wretched, and she lay down on her bed.

units.source_text: 母亲看见她这般模样，甚是吃惊，问道：“你为什么今天和往常不同？

en.t: Her mother saw her in this state, was greatly startled, and asked, "Why are you so different from usual today?

units.source_text: 面色非常青白，且又消瘦了呢！”

en.t: Your face is terribly pale, and you have grown thin as well!"

units.source_text: 乳母答道：“小姐近来身体一直不好，饮食也不大进，每日只是愁眉不展。”

en.t: The nurse replied, "The young lady has been unwell lately, she hardly eats, and every day she only looks troubled and downcast."

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人道：“真奇怪！

en.t: The wife of the Hitachi governor said, "How strange!

units.source_text: 难道是有鬼魂作祟？

en.t: Could some spirit be causing this?

units.source_text: 说是有喜呢，看来也不对，石山进香不是为了身子不净而作罢的么？”

en.t: To say she is with child does not seem right either; was the pilgrimage to Ishiyama not called off because of bodily impurity?"

units.source_text: 浮舟听了这话，心中异常难过，头也抬不起来。

en.t: Hearing these words, Ukifune felt unbearably distressed and could not even raise her head.
